message:
Merge dev (T-3041, #1685) into T-2383's gable cornice

Five conflicts, all in append-only or generated files, resolved by
keeping both sides and rebuilding the generated ones rather than by
hand-picking rows:

- docs/LIBERTIES.md, docs/STATUS.md — both sides added an entry; both
  entries are kept.
- data/liberties.json — recompiled from the merged register
  (tools/compile_liberties.py, 993 liberties).
- data/sidecars/1835/sources/index.json — rebuilt
  (tools/compile_source_use.py, SOURCE USE PASS, 559 sources).
- assets/manifest.web.json — dev's row set, with this branch's 23
  frame_tavern masters re-derived and re-recorded over it
  (tools/web_derivatives.sh --only).

Sidecars recompiled. validate.py --stale is clean: the fort house dev
brought is a different archetype and nothing here re-stales it.
